notes.title: Windstorm - The long awaited update is here!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/93f4463c44e08ecfa1d288026030141129906cd7.jpg

Dear Windstorm fans, 
 
since our initial release this summer, we’ve received plenty of suggestions, feedback and wishes from you; for that, and your ongoing support, we’d like to express our heartfelt gratitude.  

Today, we’re excited to share our first big update with you, which not only addresses technical issues, but also introduces all-new adventures with Mika and Windstorm.  

Below, you’ll find a comprehensive list of all changes made to the game. We hope you continue to enjoy exploring the lush world around Estate Kaltenbach with Mika and her best friend.  

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/981aacb0dc2ed71acc3c6aa787f86e0246439103.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/995be6dc786454880cabe7e3841ccab3be9799ec.jpghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/8b84efdb2c7547983e63867eded28b34baf5c40c.jpg
 

 Extended mission length and improved balancing 
Added new missions to the “Free Ride” mode which can be unlocked after successfully completing story missions 
Added difficulty settings to the options menu (Riding Beginner, Horse Lover, Horse Whisperer, Nojrsodsch) 
Added variable weather / time of day scenarios to missions and Free Riding 
Controller support added 
New lines and voice overs for various characters, such as Tinka 
General UI improvements 
General bug fixes with the collision detection, world map, sound bugs and graphical optimizations  
Improved performance on lower end hardware, such as laptops 
Introduced a game launcher that’s checking hardware and automatically adjusts graphical settings 
The game is also now available in Polish language
